owner: Existing Powerhouse Security Operations / website delivery
root_cause: An alternative Netlify API upload of only changed PW HTML pages succeeded without staging the _headers file. The public coach and legacy root lost CSP, X-Frame-Options and nosniff although the canonical protected GitHub→Netlify workflow generates strict hashed policies.
prevention_rule: Only the original authorized GitHub→Netlify pipeline may be treated as a secured PW release. Independently check actual provider headers on all published PW routes, including the legacy root sharing localStorage, after EVERY release and four times daily through the original security-operations-proof workflow. Fail closed on any missing or weaker CSP, blocked network egress, framing, caching or MIME protections; never equate a successful upload with security proof.
regression_contract: The existing monitor must exercise Bedrijfsgeheugen public, PW root, PW zaal and PW veld. The PW root is required to have script-src 'self', script-src-attr 'none', connect-src 'self', noindex and no-store. Both coaches require per-build SHA-256 CSP, frame-ancestors none, XFO DENY, nosniff and no-store. Preserve the original weekly DR/credential/IAM closure; add four lightweight daily live checks with no duplicate scheduler or Make.

evidence.actual_before: Independent production HEAD showed absent CSP, XFO and nosniff across PW root, zaal and veld.
evidence.actual_after: Independent HTTPS HEAD on all three PW routes confirms the strict policy and MIME/frame/cache protections.
evidence.business: Bedrijfsgeheugen production homepage/portal return 200 and previously exposed internal repository assets return 404; main site script CSP remains report-only by design.
evidence.supabase: 208 public tables RLS enabled; one intentionally token-gated anon SECURITY DEFINER cron gateway remains an open, separately gated IAM migration.
evidence.candidate_status: Recurring four-a-day main-branch workflow change remains unproven until protected merge and actual scheduled run.

proof_boundary: No 100%-hack-proof guarantee, no assertion that the unauthenticated token-gated cron gateway is fully closed, no guarantee that a privileged direct Netlify upload cannot bypass security headers without immediate monitoring detection.
customer_outcome: Prevent previously observed security header regressions from being silently presented as a safe release. Keep youth data origin and company systems under explicit monitoring without disabling normal coaching or commercial workflows.
